    MATCH (j:WebQSPEntity {name: $name, example_id: $example_id})-[r:RELATED]->(e:WebQSPEntity)

       OR toLower(r.predicate) CONTAINS 'speak'
       OR toLower(r.predicate) CONTAINS 'official'
    RETURN j.name AS source, r.predicate AS predicate, e.name AS target
""", parameters={"name": "Jamaica", "example_id": "WebQTest-0"}, limit=20)
